description.short_caption: Exophytic, verrucous lesions on the glans penis.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows multiple exophytic, verrucous lesions on the glans penis. The lesions are irregular, cauliflower-like in appearance, and vary in size. The surrounding skin appears hyperpigmented but otherwise unremarkable. The findings are consistent with condyloma acuminata, commonly caused by human papillomavirus (HPV).
visible_findings: lesions localized to the glans penis
